meta.automatic: Automatic review of a new commit

settings.title: AI code review
settings.description: An AI agent reads a ticket's pull request and tells you whether it implements the acceptance criteria, with evidence and code issues.
settings.loadError: We could not load the AI code review settings.
settings.saveError: We could not save this setting.
settings.unavailable: No usable AI provider is configured for this workspace. An owner or admin can set one up below.

notice.title: Your code is sent to a third party
notice.body: When this is on, the changes of the pull requests you review (the diff) and the ticket text are sent to {{provider}} ({{model}}), an outside processor, to produce the review. Nothing is sent while it is off. Do not turn it on for code that your agreements do not allow to leave.

enable.label: Enable AI code review
enable.description: Lets members with edit permission run a review from a task.

auto.label: Review new commits automatically
auto.description: When a linked pull request is opened, updated or marked ready, a review starts without anyone asking. Each commit is reviewed once.

token.label: GitHub access token (private repositories)
token.help: Optional. A read-only token (Pull requests: read) lets the review read private repositories. It is stored encrypted, only used for repositories your tasks already link to, and never shown again.
token.notSet: No token saved. Public repositories work without one.
token.invalid: That does not look like a GitHub token.

usage.label: Used today
usage.reset: The count restarts at midnight UTC.

problems.PROVIDER_UNKNOWN: The saved provider is not supported. Choose a provider below.
problems.KEY_MISSING: The workspace API key is missing. Save it below.
problems.BASE_URL_INVALID: The endpoint must be a valid HTTPS URL without credentials, query or fragment.
problems.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: No provider and API key are saved for this workspace.
problems.KEY_UNREADABLE: The saved key cannot be read (the server encryption key may have changed). Replace it.
problems.BASE_URL_PRIVATE: The endpoint resolves to a private or reserved network address. Choose a public HTTPS endpoint.
problems.BASE_URL_UNRESOLVED: The endpoint host could not be resolved. Check the address.

provider.title: AI provider
provider.description: Choose the provider and key this workspace uses. The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
provider.label: Provider
provider.modelHint: Leave empty to use the provider default ({{model}}).
provider.baseURLHint: HTTPS only. Private and local addresses are rejected.
provider.presetHint: The endpoint comes from the chosen provider. You can change the model.
provider.keyHint: Write-only. Leave empty to keep the saved key.
provider.keyKeep: A key is already saved. Leave empty to keep it.
provider.testHelp: Sends a short test message with no workspace content.
provider.removeBody: The key and provider are deleted and AI is turned off for this workspace. Existing reviews and plans stay available.
provider.saveError: We could not save the AI provider.
provider.testError: We could not test the connection.

errors.urlHttps: The URL must start with https://.
errors.urlCredentials: The URL must not contain credentials, query parameters or a fragment.

testCodes.AI_AUTH: The provider rejected the key. Check it and try again.
testCodes.AI_RATE_LIMIT: The provider is limiting requests. Try again later.
testCodes.AI_BAD_REQUEST: The provider refused the test request.
testCodes.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The provider is having problems. Try again later.
testCodes.AI_TIMEOUT: The provider took too long to answer.
testCodes.AI_UNREACHABLE: The provider could not be reached. Check the URL.
testCodes.KEY_UNREADABLE: The saved key cannot be read. Replace it.
testCodes.BASE_URL_PRIVATE: The endpoint is a private or reserved address.
testCodes.BASE_URL_UNRESOLVED: The endpoint host could not be found.
